description.value: New York Marriott Marquis is a Marriott hotel on Times Square in the Theater District. It is one of the largest hotels in the city, with the Marquis Theatre inside the building. Broadway theaters, the TKTS booth and Bryant Park are all within a short walk. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The hotel has a fantastic location and the rooms are very clean”. Representative watch-outs: “it can get a bit noisy at night”; “the hotel charges a mandatory $40 daily fee”.
